edgeSafety.movingActors: May cross ground overlays normally; these pieces have no standing depth and stay below all actors
edgeSafety.coverage: Fourteen authored c01-02 placements only; all other levels retain their existing presentation

integrationOrder: fixed ground/light/bridge layers, then buildings/scenery/actors by shared world foot y/x; foreground above
provenance: candidate01MapSceneryLayers + terrainLayerPieces + candidate01UnitPicture + shared BoardDepthOrder; no SVG material substitutions

samplingComparison.method: uniform placement scale of actual field BoardPieces; identical source and upper layers
samplingComparison.status: 1024 selected at 1 source pixel/unit; 512 alternative preserves 2 source pixels/unit
samplingComparison.densityWarning: Display 2x of the selected broad field is enlarged existing art, not new native2x source detail

limitations: Static initial unit poses, no animation, browser or GPU playback
Explicit diagnostic blue/red owner colors; no HUD, camera effects or CSS lighting
Legacy shore, vertical crossings, non-base surfaces and decals remain visible; footpoint occlusion may hide actors behind tall canopies; no tactical fade is applied
